description: This file defines a template-based Factory class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace, providing mechanisms for creating, managing, and iterating over factory objects that produce and handle base objects identified by unique identifiers. It includes internal classes for factory instances, an iterator for traversing factories, and methods for creating, destroying, and retrieving factory elements.

classes.name: FactoryType
classes.description: A template class managing a collection of factory instances that produce objects of type BASEOBJECT, identified by IDENTIFIER. It provides methods for creating, destroying, and accessing factories and their elements, as well as an iterator for traversing the collection.

classes.name: FactoryType::Iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the map of factory instances within FactoryType, allowing iteration over each factory's identifier and statistics.

methods.name: DestroyFactories
methods.description: Deletes all factory instances managed by the FactoryType object.

methods.name: DestroyFactory
methods.description: Deletes a specific factory identified by the given identifier.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory for a specific element type with an initial queue size, identified by the element's static Id().

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a new factory with a specified identifier and initial queue size.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a proxy to an element of type ACTUALELEMENT from the factory identified by the given identifier.

methods.name: Element
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the base object associated with the specified identifier.

methods.name: Factories
methods.description: Returns an iterator to traverse all factories managed by this FactoryType instance.
